notes.title: Weekly update - September 12
Weekly update - August 30
Weekly update - August 22
notes.content:
[p]⚠️ The Weekly Patch is Live!
[/p][p]🆕 New Features: [/p][p]+ Added off-hand support – items can now be switched between hands using the \[~] key;[/p][p]+ Added several new stages to the main questline for new Metalwork Station;[/p][p]+ Added 125 variations of blocks/slabs/stairs/slopes for metal_paneling/flooring blocks;[/p][p]+ Added ability to change number on numbered blocks with interaction menu (01-09);[/p][p]+ Added sounds for various interface elements and inventory interactions;[/p][p]+ Added several variations of death sounds for the endoskeleton;[/p][p]+ Added a new optimized and visually improved precipitation system:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed CPU-side lags, particle calculations are now performed on the GPU;[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary pixel rendering;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased rendering distance from 8 to 16 blocks;[/p][/*][*][p]Raindrops now fall at a slight random angle;[/p][/*][*][p]Snow particles fall with swirls;[/p][/*][*][p]Rain and snow particles are illuminated with global light;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the rain color to a more natural one;[/p][/*][/list][p]
♻️ Changes:[/p][p]~ Sound files in the web version are now forcibly updated, bypassing the cache when new versions are released;[/p][p]~ Changed the recipe for METALWORK_STATION so it can be crafted at the CARPENTRY_TABLE;[/p][p]~ Snowball hits now account for target movement and lag;[/p][p]~ Removed ice generation on water in Taiga biomes;[/p][p]~ Optimized methods related to physics;[/p][p]~ First-person walking and running animations have been updated;[/p][p]~ Adjusted the volume and variety of some sounds of different entities;[/p][p]~ Updated sounds of hand strikes as well as wooden, stone, and metal tools;[/p][p]~ Changed text style in F3 debug screen;[/p][p]~ Changed the sound of flowing water;[/p][p]~ Changed the sound of flowing lava;[/p][p]~ Changed the rain sound;
[/p][p]🐞 Bug Fixes:[/p][p]* Possible fix: all entities were invisible on certain PC configurations: please contact us if it worked!;[/p][p]* Fixed the quests main_before_carpentry_table and main_carpentry_table_resources to match the current CARPENTRY_TABLE recipes;[/p][p]* Fixed "Queue is full" error when clicking on fabrication ingredients in inventory;[/p][p]* Fixed rare errors when copying or opening files in terminals and portals;[/p][p]* Fixed a bug where POINTED_DRIPSTONE had the texture of POINTED_SANDSTONE;[/p][p]* Fixed an issue where killed monsters could continue attacking the player;[/p][p]* Fixed faulty flash drives without storage that couldn’t be written to;[/p][p]* Fixed bug with the crosshair disappearing during gameplay;[/p][p]* Fixed invisible snowball flight for network players;[/p][p]* Fixed incorrect snowball hits;[/p][p]* Fixed chickens laying eggs incorrectly;[/p][p]* Fixed monster behavior when losing a target;[/p][p]* Fixed a bug due to which AUZURE_LEAVES and GLOWING_AZURE_LEAVES were not broken by a sword;[/p][p]* Fixed a bug where the CLINGCLAP_MUSHROOMS block did not have mining/placing sounds, and could not be broken with a sword>        * Now it also breaks instantly;[/p][p]* Fixed an issue where many variations of lab blocks were not displayed in the appropriate section in Creative mode;[/p][p]* Small fixes in Russian localization;[/p]

notes.title: Alpha testing has begun!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45233976/055807665411380b172e8d7103f7de0180913fbe.png[/img]

Good afternoon, explorers!

Starting today, access to the Tesera playtest is open to everyone!
Just click on the “Request Access” button on the game page and you will be automatically given access to install the client.

Please note that the game is just now entering the alpha testing stage, and there is still a lot of work to be done. Many aspects of the game are not yet finalized or will change over time. But any feedback is always welcome, both here and on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8C72nfZ3WR]Discord[/url] server.

The main focus of this testing phase is to test how local worlds work. At the moment you will only be able to create a local world or join an existing multiplayer world.
In order to open your world to your friends or anyone else, load the desired world and click the 'Manage Hosting' button in the 'WORLD' box inside the game.

All created worlds can be used with the next versions of the game and after the final release.

We count on your support!
